templateManaged.description: Upgrade runner supplied by the current template release.
Ordered codemods supplied by template releases.

generatedOnce.description: Template provenance and selected generation profile.
Root commands and dependencies; migrations may change named keys only.
Generated from repository ownership choices and then owned downstream.
Generated defaults that downstream repositories may extend.
Generated onboarding content that downstream repositories normally customize.
Upgrade guidance added once and never replaced automatically.

applicationOwned.description: Domain, contract, data, UI, and platform libraries.
Deployment and environment configuration after generation.
Downstream architecture, operations, and product documentation.
Downstream delivery policy and repository automation.

conflictPolicy.templateManaged: Replace only from a verified template release artifact.
conflictPolicy.generatedOnce: Apply explicit structured edits or create missing files; report conflicts instead of overwriting customized content.
conflictPolicy.applicationOwned: Never overwrite automatically. A migration must emit manual guidance when application code requires a change.
